rationale.initialRenderEstimateKiB: Keep the homepage first render (HTML, stylesheet and head scripts) within about 1.3 KiB of the reviewed Brotli estimate.
rationale.offlineShellEstimateKiB: Allow about 1.6 KiB above the reviewed estimate for the precached shell: both pages, the offline page, hashed assets and the worker.
rationale.coldFirstSessionTransferKiB: The cold session counts the page visit plus the worker's precache fetches, which re-request the shell; allow about 5% headroom.
rationale.warmRepeatVisitTransferKiB: A repeat visit re-fetches only the network-first HTML; keep it within about 1 KiB of the reviewed measurement.

manualChecksStillNeeded: Assistive-technology coverage, additional browser/device combinations, and human usability validation are tracked in VALIDATION.md.
Production-network transfer and CDN compression are not measured by this local run.
wsg-check remains a targeted homepage scanner and is not treated as blanket WSG conformance.
